title: Best Gorgias alternatives for ecommerce teams in 2026
summary: Compare seven Gorgias alternatives for ecommerce teams, from AI overlays that install inside Gorgias to full platform replacements like Kustomer and Zendesk.
body_markdown:
### Can I add better AI to Gorgias without switching helpdesks?


Yes. Yuma installs inside Gorgias as an AI overlay, replacing the native AI Agent while keeping your helpdesk and macros in place. Your team stays in the same Gorgias workspace.


### Will my Gorgias macros and workflows transfer to a new platform?


Your Gorgias macros and workflows won't automatically transfer to a new[AI customer service platform](https://yuma.ai/blogs/best-ai-customer-service-platforms) . Gorgias macros, rules, and automations are platform-specific, so a full switch means rebuilding them.


That's a key advantage of the overlay path. Yuma keeps your existing Gorgias macros working. They stay in your helpdesk, and Yuma's Handbook references them where they apply.


### What's the best Gorgias alternative for Shopify?


The best Gorgias alternative for Shopify depends on whether you want to keep Gorgias or switch platforms.


If you want to keep Gorgias and upgrade the AI, Yuma installs inside Gorgias and takes autonomous actions in Shopify and the commerce tools around it.


If you want to switch platforms entirely, Kustomer and Zendesk both offer strong Shopify integrations, and Yuma can install inside either as the AI layer. Re:amaze is also a good option for brands running multiple Shopify storefronts.


### How long does it take to migrate from Gorgias?


Migration time from Gorgias depends on what you're switching to. An AI overlay like Yuma installs inside Gorgias without migration, and Yuma's team handles the setup through white-glove onboarding. A full platform switch can take at least two to six weeks, depending on the complexity of your macros, rules, and workflow rebuilds.
